wget.description: Downloads a file from a URL to a local path using the external wget.exe binary.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: The source URL to download from.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: The destination file or folder path.

parameters.name: dynamicUnits
parameters.description: If true, downloaded, total, speed, and eta in onProgress will be formatted strings.

returns.description: A promise that resolves with the final path of the downloaded file, or rejects on error.

wget.usage: wget(from, to, optionsonProgressdynamicUnitsthrottlenoCheckCertificatetimeoutuserAgent, , onProgress, dynamicUnits, throttle, noCheckCertificate, timeout, userAgent) : Promise.<string>
